Principle 7: My Job
Why did I Choose My Job?
When I was young, my dream was to be an English teacher, but I didn’t study English hard too.
I studied engineering instead.
After I graduated from my university, I got a job in that field.
What do I Think about My Job?
When I first started my job, I realized that what I had majored in university and what I was doing at my job were very different.
For a while, adjusting to this was very stressful.
Now I have been there for almost (Number) years, and I still work hard to become the best in my field.
We usually start and end the day with a meeting.
By always working hard, I can make sure that I am trying to improve myself.
What do I Do on My Job?
I sometimes go on business trips once a quarter.
I have to go to a seminar where I receive valuable training.
Each quarter, I stop by the smaller branches of my company and check on their progress.
I also have to do end-of-the-month evaluations for these branches and present them to my boss.
When things are not progressing as they should, it is very stressful for me.
When things are improving, my boss gives me recognition, which I am very happy to receive.
How do I Progress in My job?
I have to continually learn and improve my skills throughout my career.
These days, my company is requiring that all of its employees learn English, so I am studying hard to improve my English language skills.
